text: {"lessons":["I should not sell winners simply to lock in gains; decisions should reflect each stock’s outlook and its role in the portfolio.","Selling Stock E at a steep loss was painful, but I should reassess positions objectively rather than let loss aversion keep me invested—or push me into a rushed sale.","I should consider the whole portfolio and changing prices when trading, instead of reacting to average cost or one period’s account gain or loss."]}
